title.zh: Type-II 二进角胞的结构输入
title.en: Structural inputs for the Type-II dyadic corner cell

description.zh: 把 Type-II 角胞 (1,1) 的深次弧积分拆成三块可独立验证的结构输入：宽弧带的闭性、Fejér 核的平方展开，以及 Möbius 截断恒等式。
description.en: Split the deep-minor integral of the Type-II corner cell (1,1) into three independently checkable inputs: closedness of the wide-arc band, the Fejér square expansion, and the truncated Möbius identity.
